 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Two of the most popular teams in the NFL will go head-to-head on Sunday afternoon as the San Francisco 49ers travel to Texas to take on the Dallas Cowboys.
 Brock Purdy has never lost to the Cowboys. The 49ers have beaten Dallas a handful of times in a row by at least six points. Will that change today?
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Niners' defense will have its hands full. The Cowboys have been excellent offensively at times. Then they'll go multiple possessions where you'll see a clunky operation full of penalties and mistakes. Preying on and forcing mistakes has been the name of the game for Raheem Morris's unit this season.
 On the other side of the ball, the only team to slow down the 49ers offense is themselves. Kyle Shanahan and Brock Purdy have spoiled fans to a point where something must be wrong if the offense goes a drive without scoring.
 Christian McCaffrey should run wild in a game where points should be pouring in. It's not a trap game, but it is a tricky spot with the travel and injuries the Niners are dealing with.
